items: The hoofed animals are redrawn as low-poly models on skeletons: stag, elk, roe deer, ram, ibex and boar, each with its own baby, young, adult and legend, at the sizes they were
They have cloven hooves, and antlers, horns and tusks that grow with them: a fawn has none, a legend's are vast, mossy or banded, with lit points
The stag, elk, ram and boar trot; the roe deer and the ibex spring along stiff-legged at speed
Asleep, deer, sheep and goats fold their forelegs under them; their legends curl up on their sides in plate armour cut with glowing runes
